SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "r".race <> '-' AND "r".id IN (SELECT "s2".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g2" ON "g2".id = "s2".gender_id WHERE "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s2".race_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "g2".gender = 'Female') = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".publisher_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM "publisher" WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "target".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "h".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "eye".id WHERE "target".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other".publisher_id <> "p".id LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT "s".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".full_name = 'Charles Chandler'), "race_counts" AS (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race), "ranked" AS (SELECT race, superhero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY superhero_count DESC) AS "race_rank" FROM "race_counts") SELECT race, superhero_count FROM "ranked" WHERE race_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("pc".power_count, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "pc" ON "pc".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '^[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_height_cm", AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".height_cm FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "s3".id AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0) AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour ILIKE 'Green' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "recorded_weights" AS (SELECT id, weight_kg FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0), "lightest_heroes" AS (SELECT id FROM "recorded_weights" WHERE weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "recorded_weights")), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "lh".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "lightest_heroes" AS "lh" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "lh".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "lh".id) SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

WITH "top_speed" AS (SELECT MAX("ha".attribute_value) AS "max_speed" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed'), "fastest" AS (SELECT "ha".hero_id FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT max_speed FROM "top_speed")) SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "fastest" AS "f" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "f".hero_id WHERE "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "s_brown".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "s_brown" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "s_brown".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_good" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".weight_kg FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp3".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp3" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "p" ON "p".power_id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0) AS "h" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ua IS NOT NULL AND (("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5))) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest_rnp" AS (SELECT MAX("rnp"::NUMERIC) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative'), "rnp_tests" AS (SELECT l.* FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest_rnp" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::NUMERIC = "s".max_rnp), "max_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_tbil" FROM "rnp_tests" WHERE "T-BIL" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "r"."T-BIL", "r"."date", "r"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "rnp_tests" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "r"."id" CROSS JOIN "max_bilirubin" AS "m" WHERE "r"."T-BIL" = "m".max_tbil LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT id FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER > 10) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') SELECT id, anti_rnp_titer FROM "titers" WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM "titers") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lr" ON "lr"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' AND "lp"."plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "lr"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "lr"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "lr"."rnp"::NUMERIC > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "avg_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" GROUP BY "e".id) AS "examined" ON "examined".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "examined".id IS NULL GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN '+' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN '-' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 16 GROUP BY CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN '+' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN '-' END ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MAX("l"."rnp"::NUMERIC) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l"."rnp" IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_count > 0) AS "with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_count = 0) AS "without_normal_platelet_result" FROM (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".plt) FILTER (WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "normal_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER > 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "women", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "men" FROM "qualifying_patients" AS "q" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "q".id LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date")::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."birthday")::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER >= 64 AND "p"."birthday" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY n DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / COUNT(*) FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("first_exam".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL) AS "first_exam" ON TRUE WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "first_exam".first_exam_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "l"."U-PRO" = '>=1000') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "count_difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%RA%' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l"."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO", "p".admission AS "admission status", "l".id AS "patient ID", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission ORDER BY "l"."T-CHO" DESC) AS "reading_rank" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-CHO", "admission status", "patient ID" FROM "ranked" WHERE reading_rank = 1 ORDER BY CASE "admission status" WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "patient ID" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX("l2".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

WITH "high_proteinuria" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')), "sole_sle" AS (SELECT id, admission FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis = 'SLE') SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(')) AS "admitted_to_hospital", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "followed_at_outpatient_clinic" FROM "sole_sle" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "high_proteinuria") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_samples" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_samples" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ls".id WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "s" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "s".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa::TEXT NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'none', '0') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::REAL < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp, rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative'), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "e".rnp_value = "h".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT(*) AS "normal-range lactate dehydrogenase measurements" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "overall_max" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "level" FROM "patient_rnp") SELECT "pr".id, "pr".sex, "pr".highest_rnp FROM "patient_rnp" AS "pr" INNER JOIN "overall_max" AS "om" ON "pr".highest_rnp = "om".level LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "first_lab" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "max_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 AND "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 3) AS "ranked" ON "ranked".id = "p".id ORDER BY "ranked".max_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' OR "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%') AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) SELECT "e".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_elevated_anti_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "x" ON "x".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".care_setting ORDER BY "e".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "li".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "max_result" AS (SELECT MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "highest_dna" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "sle_patients" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id CROSS JOIN "max_result" AS "m" WHERE "l".dna::NUMERIC = "m".highest_dna LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "latest_igg".igg > 900 AND "latest_igg".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" USING (id) GROUP BY setting ORDER BY setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "current_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "most_recent" AS "m" ON "l".id = "m".id AND "l".date = "m".latest_date) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "current_results" AS "c" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id WHERE "c".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "c".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "latest" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

WITH "confirmed_sle" AS (SELECT id, admission FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[,;[:space:]])SLE([,;[:space:]]|$)'), "care" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+(') AS "outpatient_clinic", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(')) AS "in_either_setting", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients_in_either_setting" FROM "confirmed_sle") SELECT inpatients, outpatient_clinic, ROUND(100.0 * inpatients_in_either_setting / NULLIF(in_either_setting, 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "care" LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 AND ("protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)', '+3(300)', '+4(1000)', '+1(300)') OR ("protein_lab"."U-PRO" >= '100' AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" <= '999' AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$')) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "sex" IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "sex" ORDER BY CASE "sex" WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '-') AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".id IN (SELECT "sm_lab".id FROM "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" WHERE "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0')) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "protein_lab".id FROM "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" WHERE "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')) AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rb" ON "rb".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rp" ON "rp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "rb".rbc IS NOT NULL AND ("rb".rbc <= 3.5 OR "rb".rbc >= 6.0) AND "rp".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "rp".rnp <> 'negative' AND "rp".rnp::INTEGER > 0 GROUP BY "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date >= "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' * 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type = '-' LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "u"."bond group", SUM("u"."difference") AS "carcinogenic minus non-carcinogenic" FROM (SELECT "m"."molecule_id", "m"."label", CASE WHEN BOOL_AND("b"."bond_type" = '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond group", CASE WHEN "m"."label" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS "difference" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" GROUP BY "m"."molecule_id", "m"."label") AS "u" GROUP BY "u"."bond group" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c"."atom_id" = "a1"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c"."atom_id2" = "a2"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a1"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" WHERE "m"."label" = '+' AND "a2"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" AND "a1"."element" = 'c' AND "a2"."element" = 'c' AND "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" AND "b"."bond_type" = '=' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count", ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' AND "a2".element = "a".element) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a3" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m3" ON "m3".molecule_id = "a3".molecule_id WHERE "m3".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY bonded_atom_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 'single' WHEN '=' THEN 'double' WHEN '#' THEN 'triple' END AS "bond type", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other_atom" ON "other_atom".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element NOT IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "n" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "n".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "n".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id WHERE "n".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id AND "n".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "qualifying_molecules" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" WHERE "a"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / "totals".total, 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b2".molecule_id) AS "total" FROM "bond" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".bond_type = '#') AS "totals" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label, "totals".total LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" GROUP BY "a2".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "total_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "total_bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id), "carbon_touching" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".total_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".total_bond_count, 0) AS "total_bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("ct".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".total_atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_touching" AS "ct" ON "ct".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, total_atom_count, total_bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "y" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "cy" ON "cy".atom_id = "y".atom_id OR "cy".atom_id2 = "y".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "cy".bond_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "ch" ON "ch".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON ("h".atom_id = "ch".atom_id OR "h".atom_id = "ch".atom_id2) WHERE "y".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' AND "y".molecule_id = "h".molecule_id AND "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND ("a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AND "a1".element <> "a2".element GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element) || '|' || GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element)) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id2 HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "singly_only" ON "singly_only".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element <> 'na' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "e".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a".element, "a".molecule_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' UNION ALL SELECT "a".element, "a".molecule_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AS "e" GROUP BY "e".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "e".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
